parameters.time: 38 h dry milling + 5 h wet milling (45 h total)

evidence.quote: Intermittent dry milling was conducted for 38 hours at 300 r/min, followed by wet milling for 5 hours at 200 r/min using anhydrous ethanol as a process control agent.

The 45-hour milled powders were then consolidated into bulk form using SPS (LABOX-3010KF, Japan) at 1100 ± 15 ℃ for 10 min under a constant pressure of 35 MPa. The average heating rate was 65 ℃ /min, and the vacuum pressure was maintained below 5 Pa.

alongside its optimally comparative variant Cr29Fe27Ni32Nb6Mo2W2B2 (designated as TV and MW, respectively)
